title: Jazz parties like Dick Gibson's
summary: Wilson likes the parties as reunions of old friends even though sets can come very late.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, what about jazz parties now and then?
Yeah, those are all right. Yeah. What I like about those, it's like a reunion, I see fellows there I only see once a year. Trummy Young is going to come from Honolulu, with guys from California.

And the ones from New York, too. It's like a big family get together every year. So that's what makes those things very special. And plus you get a chance to play, too. Gibson may put you together, he may put
you on at seven o'clock and then you might have to hand around until two A.M. to go on to play the last set -- but it's good, it's a party; a jazz party.
